content.text:
**Finding: deviation (Section 19.2), redline validated and submitted.**

The warranty package is mostly sound — §19.1 (professional/workmanlike, conformance to documentation), §19.3 (no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law), §19.4 (re-perform/repair/replace, then termination plus refund, non-exclusive for fraud/IP/confidentiality/privacy/security/indemnified claims), and §19.5 (disclaimer expressly does not limit express warranties or remedies).

The single gap is duration and remedy survival: §19.2 caps the Deliverable conformance warranty at fifteen days and then says Vendor "has no correction or refund obligation," which extinguishes the §19.4 remedy — below even our 90/30 fallback. Our edit extends to twelve months for Deliverables and software, ninety days for Services, and confirms the §19.4 remedies apply to nonconformities reported within the period.
